label.purpose: Ruled-table dt, photo caption label, footer legal line. Never uppercase, never a kicker.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action pill: quote request, header CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #005ca9; background: #005ca9; color: #fff; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004a8a; border-color: #004a8a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2db8c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Alert Button
components.description: Urgent dépannage phone CTA; red is reserved exclusively for this.
components.css: .ds-btn-alert { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #ea444e; background: #ea444e; color: #fff; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-alert:hover { background: #c9303a; border-color: #c9303a; } .ds-btn-alert:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2db8c5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-weight: 600; color: #0b2a4a; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #0b2a4a; border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: #21313e; font: inherit; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 3px solid #2db8c5; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #005ca9; }

components.name: Ruled Fact Table
components.description: Definition-list styled as a form's field/value table; hero facts, qualifications, address block.
components.css: .ds-ruled { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; column-gap: 24px; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid #0b2a4a; max-width: 60ch; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-ruled dt, .ds-ruled dd { margin: 0; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9e0e6; } .ds-ruled dt { color: #4a5a68; font-size: 0.8125rem; padding-top: 11px; } .ds-ruled dd { font-weight: 600; color: #0b2a4a; }

components.name: Checked Proof List
components.description: Real, disclosed proof items with a cyan checkmark; hover thickens the stroke and tints the row. The one authored micro-interaction in the system.
components.html: • Devis après visite sur place jamais un prix au téléphone
components.css: .ds-checks { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-checks li { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px; margin-inline: -8px; max-width: 60ch; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-check-icon { color: #2db8c5; width: 1.5em; height: 1.5em; flex: none; margin-top: 0.05em; transition: stroke-width 150ms; } .ds-checks li:hover { background: #e3f6f8; } .ds-checks li:hover .ds-check-icon { stroke-width: 2.5; } .ds-muted { color: #4a5a68; }

components.name: The Cachet
components.description: Signature stamp component: logo + NAP, rotated -1.5deg, double-ruled cartouche, always overlapping the element beneath it (negative margin + z-index, never absolute positioning or a shadow).
components.html:
Dargent ThermiqueTél. 02 38 86 46 46
Contenu qui suit, mordu de 14px par le cachet
components.css: .ds-stamp-row { display: block; margin-top: -12px; } .ds-cachet { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #005ca9; outline: 1px solid #005ca9; outline-offset: 3px; color: #005ca9; background: #fbfcfd; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.35; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); max-width: 260px; position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-bottom: -14px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-cachet img { height: 34px; width: auto; margin-bottom: 8px; display: block; } .ds-cachet .ds-ln { display: block; } .ds-cachet-overlap { border-top: 1px solid #d9e0e6; padding-top: 22px; }

components.name: Marks Row
components.description: Grayscale qualification/partner logo row under a single hairline; the correct pattern that replaced a rejected bordered badge-grid ('bandeau de badges').
components.css: .ds-marks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 24px; align-items: center; margin: 16px 0 12px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #0b2a4a; } .ds-marks img { height: 44px; width: auto; filter: grayscale(1); opacity: 0.75; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-marks img:hover { filter: none; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Desktop primary nav: tab-like links flush with a 72px header, cyan underline for active/hover state.
components.html: Pompe à chaleurClimatisation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 24px 10px 22px; color: #0b2a4a; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current] { border-bottom-color: #2db8c5; color: #005ca9; }

narrative.overview:
The site is the maintenance logbook Dargent Thermique leaves after every visit: each page is a pre-printed sheet, each proof a checked box, the signature is the company's stamp. It deliberately refuses the category template — no smiling technician photo, no centered hero H1, no three equal cards, no bordered badge-bandeau of partner logos.

The build ships this literally, not decoratively: ruled definition-list tables (`<dl class="ruled">`) stand in for form fields, checkmarks are real proof items (never promises), photos are captioned "Observations :" like a technician's notes, and the `.cachet` stamp is rotated -1.5° and physically overlaps the content beneath it, as a real rubber stamp would. Depth comes only from this overlap and from ruled hairlines — there is no shadow anywhere in the stylesheet. Content density is intentionally high (600–1200 words of real prose per page): this is a regulated-industry SEO site, and the "carnet" aesthetic's usual airiness is a deliberate trade against that requirement, not an oversight.
keyCharacteristics: Three inks only: navy (ink/action), cyan (single accent, reserved), red (urgent-only)
One typeface (Archivo Variable), condensed via font-stretch for display, normal for body
No shadows; depth by overlap and hairline rules only
Numbered "sorties" (exit links) close every page, like footnotes on a form
Checked-box proof rows, never marketing kickers or claims

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: Only navy, cyan, and alert-red carry meaning. Cyan is rarity-gated to the cachet, checks, active states, and focus; red never appears except on a dépannage/urgent phone action. No other hue is introduced for decoration.

rules.name: The Pre-Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Labels (dt, caption .lbl) stay small, regular-weight, sentence case, and sit beside a bold value on its own line (dd) — a form field, not a marketing eyebrow. This is the one place a small caps-like label could have crept in as a kicker; the build never uppercases or bolds the label itself.

rules.name: The Overlap-Not-Float Rule
rules.body: The .cachet stamp must always visually bite into an adjacent element — never sit free on white space. Implementation pattern: wrap the stamp and the element it overlaps in a shared container, give the stamp position: relative; z-index: 1; and a negative bottom margin so it overlaps the ruled content that follows. Reuse this exact technique (negative margin + z-index, not absolute positioning) wherever the cachet appears.

dos: Do keep motion to 150ms CSS transitions on :hover/:active only; the checks-row cyan tint + stroke-thickening is the one authored moment, not a precedent for adding more.
Do reuse the negative-margin + z-index overlap technique for the cachet (see Elevation & Depth) rather than absolute positioning or drop shadows to fake depth.
Do use .marks (grayscale row under a hairline) for any future qualification/partner-logo listing.
Do keep cyan rare: cachet, checks, active nav/filter state, focus rings, and the single btn-cyan CTA variant — not a general-purpose accent.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (already zeroed site-wide) and the 17-18px body-text floor for this 40-75 audience.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow anywhere; this world's depth model is overlap and hairlines only.
Don't reintroduce a bordered/boxed logo grid ("bandeau de badges") — it was explicitly rejected as the generic HVAC-template look; .marks is the replacement and the only sanctioned pattern.

Don't add kickers, eyebrows, or uppercase micro-labels above headings. No eyebrow class exists in the build and none should be added; small labels stay sentence-case and sit beside their value (see The Pre-Printed Label Rule).
Don't use red (#ea444e) for anything except urgent/dépannage phone CTAs; it is not a second accent.
Don't round the corners of cards, photos, inputs, or the cachet — square is the "paper/data" shape; pill is reserved for clickable actions only.
